bonds.analysis: While the request to design a diversified portfolio across equities, bonds, and commodities is understood, my role is specifically to manage the fixed-income allocation of a portfolio. I can provide a fixed-income component of the portfolio that aligns with the moderate-risk profile, focusing on investment-grade bonds with a laddered maturity structure. The laddered structure will spread the maturities over multiple years, with no more than 30% of the portfolio maturing in any single year. This approach ensures predictable cash flows and reduces exposure to interest rate risk. Given the moderate-risk profile, we will aim for a portfolio duration of around 6 years, which is below the warning threshold of 7 years.

Given the current 0% allocation to raw materials, we recommend allocating 10% of the portfolio to these commodities to meet the target allocation, consistent with the inflation hedging and diversification goals.
